subject: Controlling visibility of tabPanels using radioButtons

messages.author: 601aa4bb4d2fbfcf
messages.subject: Controlling visibility of tabPanels using radioButtons
parts:
Is there a way to control which tabPanels are visible (in groups) using radioButtons. My current application has way too many tabPanels and I would like to provide the user with a means to control which ones are visible in sets.
For example, let's say you have 7 tabPanels, each of which show a different individual report; 7 more tabPanels, each of which show a different summary report; and then 7 more tabPanels, each of which show some graphic. I would like to set up radioButton control of which one(s) are visible by group, ie
 
Individual Reports
Summary Reports
Graphs and Plots
All
 
I would like the radioButton choice to be multiple, if possible, so the user could choose and control to view just one of the three groups of tabPanels, two of the three groups of tabPanels, or all.
 
I have played around with conditionalPanel and the individual tabPanel ids, but so far am at a wall. I suspect there is some easy way to do this, but it eludes me (not an uncommon occurrence).
 
pls-man
